doc_summary: `native_item_decorations(stack, x, y, batch)` appends custom GUI drawing after the default bar, cooldown shade and count have been painted for an item icon. The stack is the displayed stack, x/y are its icon's top-left in GUI units, the units the batch takes (no item-local translation remains active). Existing GUI helpers can draw badges, text and overlays. The shared path covers the hotbar, carried stacks, menu slots, recipe book and item tooltip icons, and the item icons of the advancement, beacon, stats and trading screens. `native_item_bar` still controls the bar separately; this hook does not suppress vanilla decorations. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_decorations@.
